signals.name: GameStop Corp.
signals.label: The meme-stock CEO just bought $26M of his own stock -- with no 10b5-1 cover
signals.detail: Ryan Cohen (Chairman/CEO) bought ~1.2M shares for $26.4M on Sept 21, 2026 (avg $22.94), lifting his stake to 40.5M shares (~9% of the company); the filing was NOT under a pre-scheduled 10b5-1 plan. A director added a $402K purchase the same day. Q2 2026 13F data shows 165 holders adding vs. 190 trimming, with Sixth Street Partners (+$82M) and Dimensional Fund Advisors (+76.4%, ~$66M) among the biggest buyers; BlackRock remains the largest disclosed holder (~$811M).
signals.takeaway: Watch whether this discretionary insider buy reignites retail/WSB momentum the way past Cohen purchases have.

signals.name: Microsoft Corp.
signals.label: Congress's most-traded stock, and Gottheimer keeps stacking it
signals.detail: MSFT is the single most-traded stock across all congressional disclosures (634 filings historically). Rep. Josh Gottheimer, a former Microsoft executive on House Intelligence, has disclosed three separate large MSFT purchases in 2026 (March calls, May stock, and an Aug 14 buy worth up to $1.54M reported Sept 14). It also remains a core institutional holding across major 13F filers.
signals.takeaway: Watch for whether Gottheimer's pattern of buying ahead of MSFT earnings windows continues into the next reporting cycle.

signals.name: IonQ, Inc.
signals.label: Quantum-computing name spikes on Reddit right as institutions quietly pile in
signals.detail: IonQ mentions surged roughly 2,300% in 24 hours on r/WallStreetBets as of Sept 23, 2026. That retail spike overlaps with institutional accumulation: Goldman Sachs added 1.72M shares (+93.8%) and Marshall Wace added 2.32M shares (+24,926%) in recent 13F filings. A small congressional purchase (Rep. Greg Steube, up to $15,000, disclosed 03/18) also shows up in the disclosure record.
signals.takeaway: Watch whether the retail mention spike is a reaction to real institutional buying or a standalone social-media pump.

signals.name: Palantir Technologies
signals.label: Congress keeps trading it while hedge funds quietly step back
signals.detail: Congress members traded PLTR 8 times in the past 6 months (4 buys/4 sells), including Rep. Gil Cisneros's late-disclosed August/September purchase now under STOCK Act scrutiny, and Rep. Suozzi's Feb 18 sale. Meanwhile the number of 13F hedge-fund holders fell from 96 (Q1 2026) to 87 (Q2 2026), even as some funds like Jennison Associates added over 10.7M shares.
signals.takeaway: Watch the divergence -- congressional and retail attention staying high while the smart-money holder count shrinks.

signals.name: SpaceX (post-IPO)
signals.label: A private-market Musk company is now a congressional cluster trade
signals.detail: At least seven House members (Timmons, McGuire, Meuser, Cisneros, James, Moskowitz, and now Lisa McClain) have bought SpaceX stock since its June 12, 2026 IPO. McClain's fresh ~$250K September purchase came shortly before a Pentagon-xAI deal was announced; her family had earlier held xAI stock before it merged into SpaceX. Several of the buyers sit on committees overseeing SpaceX-relevant areas, per NOTUS/CNBC reporting.
signals.takeaway: Watch for additional disclosures as more members' 45-day filing windows close, and any ethics-committee response to the conflict-of-interest questions.

signals.name: Advanced Micro Devices

signals.detail: AMD carries a 'Strong Buy' consensus from 34 analysts as of Sept 23, 2026, and was among the tickers in Rep. Gil Cisneros's recently flagged (and reportedly late-filed) August/September trading batch. It's also a long-time top holding for other current and former congressional traders active in the semiconductor/AI space.
signals.takeaway: Watch whether Cisneros's position sizing on AMD gets broken out separately once his amended/late disclosures are fully parsed.
